ev.q: In 2022, a total of 2,804 isolates (4.1% of 68,217 gonococcal infection cases) from 13 provinces in China were tested for antimicrobial susceptibility.
Resistance rate was expressed as the percentage of resistant isolates among the total number of isolates.
Rates of reported cases ranged from 2.13 to 20.58 per 100,000 population
The prevalence of Neisseria gonorrhoeae resistance to ceftriaxone was 8.1%, approximately three times the 2017 rate of 2.9%

methods_quotes.q: Resistance rate was expressed as the percentage of resistant isolates among the total number of isolates.
Antibiotic resistance breakpoints were applied based on the European Committee on Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing criteria
The determination of antibiotic resistance was based on the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) values obtained through agar dilution.
